text: と　なげれば　ポケモンを　つかまえ　られる！

structure.en: if you throw it like that

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえ　られる！

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と here picks up the sound word ポイ from the line before and attaches it to the verb, showing the way it is done. ポイ！となげれば = 'if you throw it with a toss'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. なげれば = 'if you throw it'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる added to つかまえる means 'can' do it. つかまえられる = 'you can catch it'.
